description: What one book is about: synopsis, authors, year, series and position, genres, and its siftivo.com page. Suits "what is X about" and "is X part of a series". For a reader who has linked their Siftivo account it also suits "would I like X": when the book fits their taste, the result says why. Takes a workId from search_books, or a siftivo.com slug.
